data.description:
## Purpose
Choose which epics to use for the dogfooding sessions. Selection criteria: epics should be in early exploration stage (open, no preplanning run yet) so that genuine intent gaps exist and Phase 1 Gate has realistic material to challenge. Diversity of domain increases likelihood of surfacing a META_QUESTION.

## Steps
1. Run: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=epic --status=open --format=llm to get candidate epics
2. Filter for epics without 'brainstorm:complete' tag (these have not yet passed Phase 1 Gate) using: .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=epic --status=open | grep -v 'brainstorm:complete'
3. Select 3 candidate epics that represent different feature areas (avoid epics blocked on external deps or tagged scrutiny:pending without brainstorm:complete)
4. Document the 3 selected epic IDs and rationale as a comment on ticket 745a-b46d

## Done
- 3 target epic IDs documented in a ticket comment on 745a-b46d: 'DOGFOODING_TARGETS: epic1=<id>, epic2=<id>, epic3=<id>; rationale: <brief description of why each was selected>'
data.title: Select >=3 target epics for dogfooding brainstorm sessions and document selection rationale
